headline: Carhenge / Shandoka goes before Town Council on Tuesday, September 1
blurb: Three work sessions open the day: a deep look at Comprehensive Plan goals and objectives with project consultants, a Gondola Subcommittee update, and a review of proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies — that last one worth watching given how central rent policy has become to who can stay in the canyon. A second work session later covers AMI increases and rental rate adjustments for 2027 budgetary planning.
